Follow-up holes KF21023 and KF21024 successfully intersected this conductor and returned semi-massive pyrrhotite- dominated mineralization with anomalous base and precious metal values.
These results suggest that the conductive system was only partially tested and that additional drilling is warranted to evaluate the core of the anomaly and its mineralization potential.

The Phase I VTEM survey successfully identified multiple conductivity and magnetic anomalies within favourable stratigraphy, leading to the delineation of eight priority targets at Gilbert Lake, Knife Lake Deposit, and Scimitar Lake.
